items.title: Russia opens investigation and warns against travel to Crimean Bridge
items.summary: Russian authorities have reportedly opened a terrorism investigation into the November 16–17 attacks on the Crimean Bridge and urged motorists to avoid approaching the crossing. Officials say security will be increased along the overland route to Crimea and maintain that supplies remain intact, while the Kremlin has pledged to rebuild the damaged bridge. The full extent of structural damage and the reliability of alternative supply routes remain unverified.
